top_signals.title: India’s Nifty Stands Apart as Global Stocks, Gold Suffer Rare Joint Selloff
top_signals.summary: India’s equity benchmark climbed as the S&P 500, MSCI’s Asia gauge and gold each lost more than 5% last week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Tata Steel to Acquire 26.4% in APL Apollo Tubes for $1.7 Billion
top_signals.summary: Tata Steel Ltd. has agreed to acquire a 26.4% stake in APL Apollo Tubes Ltd. for as much as 155.1 billion rupees ($1.7 billion), deepening its presence in India’s structural steel products market.

top_signals.title: Hiroshima joins forces with bus operators to redraw local routes
top_signals.summary: The public-private partnership involving eight operators aims to optimize the network in the face of declining ridership and financial challenges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
